questions.question:
Select the option that will correctly replace the question mark (?) in the series.

1, 2, 11, 36, ?
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

Difference between consecutive numbers is square of odd numbers.

2 -1 = 1 = 1²

11 - 2 = 9 = 3²

36 - 11 = 25 = 5²

So, difference between 36 and next term is square of 7 i.e. 49

36 + 49 = 85

Hence, next term in the series is 85.

questions.question:
The statements given below are followed by two conclusions labelled I and II. Assuming that the information in the statement is true, even if it appears to be at variance with generally established facts, decide which conclusion(s) logically and definitely follow(s) from the information given in the statements.

Statements:

All guns are flowers.

All swords are flowers.

Conclusion I: Some swords are guns.

Conclusion II: No sword is a gun.

options.text: Either conclusion I or conclusion II follows.

questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/063ff23dfee066f18533d256d8a58ade2af2a814384168c7ea1104be75225063.png] 

**Conclusion:**

I. Some swords are guns → False (It is possible but not definite)

II. No sword is a gun → False (It is possible but not definite)

Both conclusions form a complementary pair.

Hence, either conclusion I or conclusion II follows.

questions.question: Due to which scientific phenomenon does a stick, when partly immersed in water, appears to be bent?
questions.solution:
• Refraction of light:- When a ray of light enters a medium from another medium (a denser medium from a rarer medium), it turns towards the normal and after leaving the dense medium, it goes away from the normal, this process is called refraction of light. Example- **a stick, when partly immersed in water, appears to be bent**.
 
• Reflection:- When a ray of light comes out of a source of light and collides with another bright surface and returns to collide, this phenomenon is called reflection of light.

Example: When the laser light is focused on the glass and the beam hits the glass and can be seen elsewhere.

 
• Dispersion: In the optics section of physics, dispersion is a phenomenon in which the velocity of a wave depends on its frequency. Sometimes the term chromatic dispersion is used for specificity.
 
• scattering:- When an atom or molecule comes in contact with light, it absorbs the light energy and emits them in different directions till the light emits, the phenomenon of emitting rays of light is called scattering of light.
